subject: Customer Pathway Worksheet - Draft & Timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmefin.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer Pathway Worksheet - initial draft

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. As promised, I attached a first-pass Customer Pathway Worksheet (Acme_PATHWAY_Worksheet_v1.gdoc) and a one-slide pilot schedule (Pilot_Schedule_v1.gslides). The worksheet is intentionally lightweight — purpose is to align owners, success criteria, and a realistic close & pilot timeline so we can move from evaluation -> prod fast.

Key asks:
- Can you nominate a primary stakeholder and an operations contact for the pilot?
- Review the acceptance criteria under section 3 and flag anything missing (security, compliance, performance).
- Are the milestones and dates in the pilot slide realistic from your side?

Proposed next steps:
1) You review the worksheet and comment directly in the doc (I set edit comments on).
2) We lock owners by EOD next Thursday (8/7).
3) Pilot kickoff the week of 8/18 if we hit the commitments.

I copied Marissa to keep the onboarding/CS plan aligned. If procurement needs a separate redline or SOW timeline, loop Procurement (procurement@acmefin.com) and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attach: Acme_PATHWAY_Worksheet_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), Pilot_Schedule_v1.gslides (Google Slides stub)

Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer Pathway Worksheet - initial draft

Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clean structure. A few quick points after scanning:
- Primary stakeholder: Jordan will be our exec sponsor. Ops: I’ll make an intro to Maria (ops lead) in a follow-up — she needs to be owner for the pilot runbook.
- Acceptance criteria: please add a short line about data retention (we typically require 12 months by policy) and an SLO for inference latency under load (p50/p95).
- Dates: the pilot kickoff week of 8/18 looks fine, but can we shift the internal readiness cutoff to 8/13 so we have a buffer?

I’ll add comments in the doc later today. Procurement wants a short mutual action timeline that maps to PO/payment milestones — I’ll pull the procurement team thread once we lock owners.

—Alex
Alex Gomez
Director, AI Programs | Acme Financial

Date: Fri, 01 Aug 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer Pathway Worksheet - initial draft

Quick ops note from infra side —

Thanks for adding the pre-kickoff checklist, Marissa. Two things I flagged in comments in the worksheet:
- Capacity sizing: we need sample QPS and average sequence length to finalize the inference config; Alex, can you share a short sample payload or expected QPS for pilot (even a rough ballpark)?
- Security approvals: if Acme requires a private deployment pattern (VPC/HSM) as part of the pilot, lead time is ~3 weeks for infra prep. That would push the kickoff to early September unless we accept a hosted pilot first.

If the goal is to keep the 8/18 kickoff, we should plan for a hosted pilot and document deployment constraints as part of the runbook. I added a note in the Acceptance section.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick summary and agreed next steps: 

Summary of decisions:
- Owners: Jordan (exec sponsor), Maria (ops lead, intro pending from Alex). Marissa will be CS lead.
- Acceptance criteria: include data retention (12 months) and latency SLOs (p50/p95) as Marissa suggested.
- Pilot: aim for hosted pilot kickoff week of 8/18 with internal readiness target 8/13; if Acme requires private deployment we'll re-assess and may shift to September.
- Procurement: procurement@acmefin.com copied to start mapping payment milestones to pilot completion.

Agreed next steps / owners:
- Alex: introduce Maria (ops) and share rough QPS/sample payload by EOD 8/6.
- Marissa: fold comments into the live worksheet and update the Pilot_Schedule slide by 8/5.
- Jonas: prepare the hosted-runbook checklist and capacity notes; flag any infra blockers by 8/7.
- Ben: I’ll update the worksheet title and push a short mutual action timeline to HubSpot (deal ACME-2025-087) after owner confirmations.

If anyone needs to adjust the owner-lock date, flag it today so we can update the slide before sending to procurement.

Best —
